official_bath_facts_seen.room_bath: not a separate indoor-room-bath axis in official sample
official_bath_facts_seen.room_open_air_bath: Official site states all rooms have open-air baths and view terraces; Google result states all guest rooms use Dogo Onsen draw-in water for room open-air baths.
official_bath_facts_seen.public_bath: Official site and JTB confirm top-floor/observatory bath.
official_bath_facts_seen.source_claims: Official wording emphasizes Dogo Onsen and guest-room open-air baths. JTB public-bath page states public bath spring use is discharge/circulation combined and heated.
official_bath_facts_seen.spring_quality: Official: soft/smooth Dogo Onsen, 'beauty water' framing. JTB: simple spring, colorless transparent, odorless, outlet 43 C.
